subject: End-of-Commitment playbook: notice windows + TfC concession sync
messages:
From: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@lumenai.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Questions on end-of-commitment notice and TfC

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement had a couple quick questions from legal about the order form we received: specifically the auto-renew cadence and the Termination for Convenience (TfC) clause. Two asks: (1) confirm what notice window Redwood expects to trigger non-renewal (we saw 60 days in the MSA, but the Order Form shows 45 days), and (2) confirm whether Redwood will consider a capped TfC liability (customer-requested).

Marcus
Senior Procurement Manager
LumenAI

---
From: ava_chen@redwood.com
To: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@lumenai.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on end-of-commitment notice and TfC

Marcus — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Kim from Legal and Karthik (AE) to align. Quick answers up front: the platform-level default is 60 days (MSA), but historically we've accepted 45 days in order forms for pilots and small POCs. TfC is negotiable in principle but typically we limit liability to fees paid in the prior 12 months — that would be the conservative starting point.

Action items I propose:
- Kim: can you confirm if we can accept a 45-day notice on this order form (LumenAI pilot) and, if so, whether we require an amendment to the MSA or can handle it as an order-form deviation?
- Karthik: if we can make the notice concession, please confirm pricing/fallout and whether we should ask for a brief non-refundable onboarding fee to offset early termination risk.

I'll coordinate responses to Marcus once we have a short position to share.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

---
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: ava_chen@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@lumenai.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on end-of-commitment notice and TfC

Thanks for the ping. Short answer: we can accept a 45-day notice on the order form for this pilot without amending the MSA, provided we include a specific carve-out in the order form that states: "Notwithstanding MSA Section X, for the term of this Order Form the notice-to-nonrenewal period shall be forty-five (45) days." That keeps the MSA intact and preserves our precedent.

On TfC: legal prefers a single liability cap tied to (i) fees paid in the prior 12 months OR (ii) an amount equal to three months' average monthly recurring revenue (whichever is greater). For pilots we can flex toward the 12-month fees cap. If sales wants to be more permissive we should capture a business justification (pilot size, potential ARR, strategic partner).

I attached a short redline (LumenAI_OrderForm_v2_redline.pdf) that:
- Adds the 45-day carve-out clause
- Adds a TfC cap option clause with the 12-month-fees default and a place to enter a negotiated cap
- Preserves auto-renew mechanics (keeps MSA language but references the carve-out)

Filed question: do we need to include an explicit offboarding SLA if TfC is granted (to protect support/entitlements)? My recommendation: include a 30-day offboarding support addendum as a schedule for pilots.

-Kim
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

---
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@lumenai.com>, ava_chen@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on end-of-commitment notice and TfC

Marcus — appreciate the patience. From a commercial perspective, we're OK with the 45-day notice for the pilot as long as we do two things: (1) include the 30-day non-refundable onboarding fee ($7,500) to cover initial provisioning and runbook creation, and (2) have a short offboarding SLA (30 days) that defines export of KV caches, access revocation, and a limited handover of logs. Those protect both sides operationally.

If LumenAI is comfortable with onboarding fee + 12-month fees liability cap, we can proceed to signatures quickly. Otherwise Kim and I will need to know the requested cap to run a final legal/commercial check.

Next step: Marcus, can you confirm you have authority to sign an order form with the onboarding fee and TfC cap (or indicate who on your side needs to approve)?

Thanks,
Karthik (AE)
Redwood Inference — Sales

---
From: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@lumenai.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ava_chen@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on end-of-commitment notice and TfC

Thanks team. I can approve the 45-day notice for the pilot but I need to take the onboarding fee and TfC cap back to procurement execs for sign-off. Procurement's leaning: onboarding fee looks reasonable, TfC cap request is to limit to fees paid in the prior 6 months (rather than 12) because of budget constraints. Can you give guidance on whether Redwood would accept 6 months for a pilot-sized deal (~$120k TCV)? Also, Marcus asks for the redline and an operational runbook for the offboarding SLA for internal review.

We reviewed the attached redline and appreciate the carve-out approach. If Redwood can accept 6 months for pilots under $150k TCV, procurement can sign off faster.

Marcus Hale
LumenAI

---
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@lumenai.com>, ava_chen@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on end-of-commitment notice and TfC

Marcus — understood. As a one-off for pilot deals under $150k TCV we can accept a 6-month fees cap on TfC, provided two conditions are documented in the order form: (1) the capped amount is explicitly stated in the Termination for Convenience paragraph, and (2) the offboarding SLA (attached runbook) is appended as Schedule 1. I attached a short runbook (notice-window-runbook.docx) that outlines responsibilities, export mechanics, and timelines.

If that works, Karthik and Ava: please update the pricing exhibit to show the onboarding fee and prepare an execution-ready order form. Marcus: if procurement confirms authority to sign, we can target signatures next week.

Best,
Kim
Senior Counsel
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: LumenAI_OrderForm_v2_redline.pdf (redline), notice-window-runbook.docx (operational runbook)]
